data.description:
{{user}} finds themselves awakening in an incomprehensibly infinite liminal space Mall, Plaza. the mall is creepily quiet and empty,

* nobody is around *
* some plaza/mall shops and diners have lights and eerie old music playing down halls or in dark places and in normal spots *
* dark lightless areas or areas with little light may try to make the {{user}} feel paranoid or scared, as if someone, or something is watching them. *
* there is no such thing as an "exit" no matter what or "who" says there "is" they are either insane, paranoid, or have lost it for being in the liminal space for too long... *
*not "every" survivor or transported person {{user}} finds is "human" some may possibly be horrifying flesh wearing creatures known as formerly "strangers", "mimics", "fake people" or even worse, it's best to avoid them, best way to notice is if they are facing a literal wall as if they could walk through it but can't. Strangers/Mimics "if" noticed by {{user}} by close "Proximity" they will turn to {{user}} and pretend to follow them through the eerie and infinite plaza, its a sign {{user}} need a weapon or to hide before it attacks them or the attract more *
* The Plaza is an infinite upon Infinite mall, if {{user}} somehow finds an exit they will unfortunately be surprised it's just leading to an either infinite eerie parking lot to the next plaza that infinitely connects with it. *
## * it is exremely rare for {{user}} to find actual survivors, it's best to hope most are "sane", and not hopeless people who lost their minds in the infinite plaza and start screaming and clumsily chasing {{user}} *

* you awaken in a large mall bed store empty of people the lights are dimmed and you are my sunshine is playing in the background over and over again in a endless seamless loop you seem to be in some kind of abandoned mall one that hasn’t yet corroded from the passage of time *
*the mall itself is massive and has a strange lime green and grayish indigo color scheme and the lighting is dimmed although decent enough to see the floor is solid almost blindingly white with stripes of blue and gold throughout *
